title: 3B Street Chatter — Поэзия и повседневная жизнь

items.example: We listened to extracts from conversations overheard on the street.
The programme finds poetry in city chatter.
We talk to poet Imtiaz Dharker about where ideas come from.
Where might a poet get their inspiration from?
What does she pay attention to in the street?
There he was, covered in mud and looking at me.
Then he realised it was in his pocket all the time.
Who gets angry over jam? She does, apparently!
The poem uses a lot of rhyming words.
All lines in the poem have the same number of syllables.
Repetition is one of the typical features of a spoken-word poem.
The poem is performed with background music.
What do you think is the overall message of the poem?
Is this something you can relate to?
I spent ages revising for my English exam.
I forgot to go over all the irregular verbs.
I was nervous about being in that talent show.
You have found out you are getting a promotion at work.
My flat was burgled last night.
